1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the alignment device comprises hardware components that produce a functional and structural interrelationship with computer software to realize the alignment computation, and wherein the alignment is computed by analyzing sequences of user actions in real-time against procedural steps to identify deviations from the documented procedure__.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, __and wherein the identification of the current step is used to control a display output that is functionally dependent on the computed alignment__.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change to the display state of the user interface based on the computed alignment__.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, __wherein the highlighting is dynamically updated based on real-time changes to the computed alignment__.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, __and wherein the identification of the next step is used to control a display output that is functionally dependent on the computed alignment__.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change to the display state of the user interface based on the computed alignment__.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, __wherein the highlighting is dynamically updated based on real-time changes to the computed alignment__.

8. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the at least one similarity metric is based on a similarity of an action type involved in both a demonstrated user action and a document action, __wherein the similarity metric comprises a comparison of action sequences and temporal relationships between actions, and wherein the comparison produces a quantitative measure that controls subsequent alignment computations__.

9. (Original) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the previous user experiences are stored in a database and used to weight the similarity metric computations__.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, __wherein the document action extractor parses the documented procedure to identify step boundaries and dependencies between steps__.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the alignment device comprises hardware components that produce a functional and structural interrelationship with computer software to realize the alignment computation__; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, __wherein the highlighting device produces a functional change to the display state of the user interface__; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, __wherein the scrolling device produces a functional change to the display position of the user interface content__.

14. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, __wherein the alignment device, highlighting device, and scrolling device operate in real-time to track user progress through the documented procedure and provide dynamic feedback__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the previous user experiences are stored in a database and used to weight the similarity metric computations__.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the computing step analyzes sequences of user actions in real-time against procedural steps to identify deviations from the documented procedure, and wherein the alignment computation produces a quantitative measure that controls subsequent system operations__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, __and wherein the identification of the current step is used to control a display output that is functionally dependent on the computed alignment__.

(Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the at least one similarity metric is based on a similarity of an action type involved in both a demonstrated user action and a document action, __wherein the similarity metric comprises a comparison of action sequences and temporal relationships between actions, and wherein the comparison produces a quantitative measure that controls subsequent alignment computations__.

27.
